summary.text: Chris Corry is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 15-Position 1 who first took office in 2019, and he is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Jack McEntire.
He represented the 14th District until redistricting placed him in the 15th District.

paragraphs.text: Corry earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Washington, where he met his wife, Jennica.
The couple moved to Southern California and later to Yakima, Jennica's hometown.
Wikipedia says Corry has worked as a risk management advisor and in the insurance industry.
Corry was elected in 2018 and took office on January 14, 2019.

His House Republican biography describes him as serving his fourth term and as a volunteer with the Salvation Army and Crime Stoppers of Yakima County and a board member of the Central Washington Fair Association.

Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Appropriations, Consumer Protection & Business, Joint Employment Relations (vice chair), Joint Legislative Unanticipated Revenue Oversight, and Pension Funding Council (chair).
